Whether reconcile repairs drift on its own.

oneOf.description: Execute drifted units whose recovery policy is `converge` again.
Leave every drifted unit to `nyl reconcile --reapply`.

EnvironmentSource.description:
The source commit of an environment's runs: a ref whose tip each run uses,
optionally pinned to a commit that `nyl update source-locks` moves, or the
commit the newest promotion recorded.

commit.description: Full 40-character lowercase commit ID that is read, refreshed by `nyl update source-locks`.

fromPromotion.description: The source commit recorded by the newest promotion on a path; excludes the other fields.

repository.description: Inline repository coordinates to read from. Mutually exclusive with `repositoryRef`.

repositoryRef.description: Project-local `gitops.nyl/v1` GitRepository to read from. Mutually exclusive with inline `repository`.

revision.description: Human-readable branch or tag that `nyl update source-locks` resolves.

admission.description: CI deployment admission: `required` makes state-writing runs use the source of the current admission. Omitted, the group's, else `off`.

allowUnprotectedSource.description: Whether runs may use source commits outside `protectedRefs`. Omitted, the group's, else `false`.

attestations.description: Environment-wide attestations, recorded with `nyl attest` for the environment's current state.

driftRepair.description: Whether `reconcile` executes `converge` units again whose latest drift observation is `drifted`. Omitted, the group's, else `converge`.

protectedRefs.description: Refs that pinned commits and run source commits must be reachable from. Omitted, the group's, else each repository's default branch.

source.description: The source commit runs use. Omitted, the commit of the worktree a run starts from.

unitSelector.description: Matches literal unit `metadata.labels` across all unit kinds. An empty selector selects every unit.

values.description: Values unit templates see as `values`, merged recursively over the values of the EnvironmentGroup selecting this environment.

EnvironmentState.description: The location of an environment's state: a repository and the refs within it.

admissionRef.description: Ref of the deployment admission record. Default the desired ref.

coordinationRefPrefix.description: Prefix, ending in `/`, of the leases, runs, and signals refs. Default `refs/nyl/`.

desiredRef.description: Ref of the desired state. A short name is a branch. Default `nyl/<environment>/desired`.

observedRef.description: Ref of the observed state; may equal `desiredRef`. Default `nyl/<environment>/observed`.

path.description: Directory of the environment's state within its refs, so several environments can share one ref. Default the root.

repository.description: Inline repository coordinates holding the state. Mutually exclusive with `repositoryRef`.

repositoryRef.description: GitRepository holding the state, read through its `repoURL` and written through its `publishURL`. Mutually exclusive with `repository`. Omitted with `repository`: the group's, else the checkout's `origin`, else the local repository.

GitOpsResourceMetadata.description: Metadata shared by local GitOps compiler resources.

labels.description: Literal labels used for organization and target selection.

name.description: Project-local identity. Must be a Kubernetes DNS subdomain and remain static during discovery.

publishURL.description: Optional Git write URL. Publication uses `repoURL` when omitted.

repoURL.description: Credential-free Git read URL used by renderers and generated Applications.

matchLabels.description: Exact label matches, combined with AND. An empty map selects every ApplicationGroup.

name.description: Project-local name of the referenced resource; its kind and API group are determined by the containing field.

PromotedSource.description: A source that promotion paths supply.

path.description: The PromotionPath that supplies the source. Mutually exclusive with `paths`.

paths.description: Several PromotionPaths; the newest record on any of them wins. Mutually exclusive with `path`.

promoted.description: The record `nyl promote` writes here with `record: source`, never by hand.

description:
A named place that units are reconciled into, with its own state.

An Environment selects units by their literal labels and gives their
templates its `values`. The selected, enabled units are its ownership set:
a unit that leaves the set is deleted under its deletion policy.

## When needed

To reconcile units with `nyl reconcile -e <environment>`.

## If omitted

No orchestration happens; rendering and publication work as before.
